array.string: EXTRA="/opt/homebrew/bin:/opt/homebrew/sbin:${HOME}/.local/share/mise/shims:${HOME}/.toolbox/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin:${HOME}/.cargo/bin:${HOME}/Library/pnpm:${HOME}/.deno/bin:${HOME}/.bun/bin" # Always rebuild the base from path_helper (/etc/paths + /etc/paths.d) rather than # from `launchctl getenv PATH`: on a fresh boot launchd has no PATH set, and getenv # prints nothing while still exiting 0 — so a `||` fallback never fires and the GUI # PATH ends up missing /usr/bin, /bin, /usr/sbin, /sbin. Deriving it fresh each run # is also idempotent, so re-loading the agent can't accumulate duplicate entries. # env -i matters: path_helper *appends* to any inherited PATH, so clear the env first # to get just the canonical system PATH and avoid inheriting a stale/duplicated one. BASE=$(eval "$(/usr/bin/env -i /usr/libexec/path_helper -s)"; printf '%s' "${PATH}") [ -n "${BASE}" ] || BASE="/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin" /bin/launchctl setenv PATH "${EXTRA}:${BASE}"
